limitations: Primary experiments were accessed only at abstract level: Orzalesi/Hay 1971 and human-blood VWF/receptor flow-chamber study 1988.
Tillman review reopen returned a browser check; prior documented project introduction-level read is disclosed. UniProt direct reopen returned JS fallback but indexed reviewed record was readable.
Legacy Reactome coagulation IDs returned 404; current initiation/amplification/fibrin/regulation pathway records were opened instead.
Numerical blood volumes/counts/MCVs and assay patterns are explicitly synthetic. Approximate 120-day normal RBC lifespan supports stationary throughput, not an exponential removal law.
No modeled coagulation rates, EPO gains/delays, fibrin mechanics or patient-specific treatment comparisons; drug mechanism categories are not prescribing recommendations.
Presentation phase timings are schematic, not measured biological kinetics.

Prepared CIL221 human RBC SEM has unspecified donor health/calibration; separate humanPRP assay uses citrate and addedthrombin with no imposedflow. Vessel image remains pathological mouse tissue, not normal human wall anatomy.
Source topic coverage uses captions and bounded sampled stills, not continuous audio/video review.
Private browser print proof is not a clean public PDF deliverable.
PRP source panels have divergent clocks and rightpanel ends beforeleft; caption100timepoints12.5s versus120encodedframes. No global biological-time conversion or measured normal clotting duration.

Alexa488 signal identifies fibrin(ogen), not independent platelet-membrane labeling. Reviewed-preprint winding mechanism causality remains incomplete; observed redistribution is the delivered movie role.
Existing lab injury/EPO/target schematics and lineage SVG remain revision-required; RBC image/movie do not waive complete hemostasis, normal differential or lineage gaps.
